rule_outs: Dwelling 3 m from the best section
summary: Very steep narrow lane with houses 3-7 m away.
reasons: Narrow lane, nowhere to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Houses 3 m at the start and 7 m at 32 m; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane between fences and hedges; no room to pull clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street running up from a through road.
drivers.convention: No parked vans seen; a single car sits at the lane edge near the start.

sun_shade: Mixed tree shade, especially from the west side.
